title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/rhythm-reality-sync.ts, stop writing a fabricated zero when the open-gap count
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/rhythm-reality-sync.ts, stop writing a fabricated zero when the open-gap count could not be read. One file, one concern.

Two anchors, each occurring exactly once.

Anchor A, indented with two spaces:
  let openGapCount = 0;
Immediately after it, declare a sibling boolean initialised false, named openGapKnown.

Anchor B, indented with six spaces:
      openGapCount = typeof data?.body?.open === "number" ? data.body.open : 0;
Rewrite that single statement so that the numeric field is assigned to openGapCount and openGapKnown is set true ONLY when the field is actually a number. When it is not, leave openGapCount at its initial value and leave openGapKnown false. Do not set openGapKnown anywhere else: the surrounding catch block and the non-ok response path must both leave it false.

Then find the point where the new staleness is computed from openGapCount and written back, and make the whole recompute-and-write step conditional on openGapKnown being true. When it is false, skip the computation and the write entirely so the stored staleness keeps its previous value.

Finally, include openGapKnown in the returned report body under the name open_gap_known, so a caller can distinguish an abstention from a genuine empty backlog.

Why this is required, precisely. Zero is not a neutral placeholder here. The value feeds staleness as the minimum of one and the count divided by a target backlog, so a zero writes a staleness of zero, which states that the family whose job is draining gaps has nothing to do. When the read fails the truth is that the count is unknown, and unknown is not empty. There are currently over a thousand open gaps, and a single failed read was enough to mark that family idle. Preserving the last known-good value on failure is correct; fabricating a zero destroys it.

Do not change the computation used when the count IS known, do not alter the request timeout, do not touch other rhythm families, and edit no other file.
